title: Logs
intro: What the service recorded, redacted before it was stored: credentials, signed link parameters and authorization headers never reach this list.

list.title: Records
list.full_page: This is a full page: older records exist behind it.
list.dropped: {count} records were dropped because the store could not keep up.
list.retention: Kept for {days} days or {records} records, whichever runs out first.

bundle.title: Diagnostic bundle
bundle.intro: An archive for a support request: versions, configuration metadata, system checks and the most recent errors. Nothing is uploaded; the file is written on this machine, and only after you have seen and approved its contents.
bundle.select_hint: Untick what the recipient should not get.

versions.description: application version, platform and the installed plugins

configuration.description: the settings document without its credentials

system_checks.description: tool locations and versions, the reverse-proxy contract

doctor.description: the same checks as `rdownloader doctor` prints them

recent_errors.description: the newest warnings and errors from the log store

redaction.configuration_credentials: fields named like a credential are replaced by [redacted]
redaction.configuration_text: text values pass through the URL and header redaction
redaction.paths: paths pass through the text redaction
redaction.log_records: messages and fields were redacted when captured; nothing is re-read from the log file

exclusion.file_contents: file contents and file names of downloads
exclusion.urls: full URLs: query values that carry a credential or a signature are replaced
exclusion.secrets: secrets: passwords, tokens, API keys, cookies, certificates and vault references
